description.en: The hybrid control module has not learned the rotor position offset for the generator. Phase commutation cannot be optimised until learning completes.

title.en: Battery Charger Coolant Control Valve Control Circuit/Open

description.en: The battery charger coolant control valve reports a control circuit/open condition. The on-board charger negotiates voltage, current and safety with the EVSE; a fault interrupts charging or limits it to AC slow-charge despite a DC fast charger being attached.
